quote: The driver of a vehicle overtaking another vehicle proceeding in the same direction shall pass to the left thereof at a safe distance and shall not again drive to the right side of the highway until safely clear of the overtaken vehicle.

activation.condition: A driver overtakes another vehicle proceeding in the same direction.

obligation.description: Pass to the left at a safe distance and remain left until safely clear before driving right again.

timing.description: From overtaking approach through the first rightward return.

judgment_calls_needed.note: The statute supplies no numeric safe-distance cutoff; preserve measured body separation for independent legal and physical review.
The statute supplies no numeric safely-clear cutoff; preserve first-return full-body order for independent legal and physical review.
